summary.text: Danny McCormick is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 1, representing Caddo, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2019 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Danny McCormick's occupation as Owner, M & M Oil.
It lists Danny McCormick's education as North Caddo High School; McNeese State University.

The House member page lists Danny McCormick's committee assignments as Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development; Commerce; Natural Resources and Environment; House Select Committee on Homeland Security.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
